findings.correction: I changed clothes, shoved the sword deep into my Inventory, then pulled out the *Sharp Spear*.
findings.current: I changed clothes, shoved my old ones deep into the black Inventory, then pulled out the *Sharp Spear*.
findings.defect: 검은 is 검+은 (the issued sword), not ‘black’. He stows the sword and draws the spear; old clothes and a ‘black Inventory’ are invented.
findings.rationale: Issued gear is a sword, black uniform, and plaque. After putting on the uniform he hides 검 and takes out [예리한 창], which the next paragraph explains he cannot summon in communal quarters.
findings.source: 옷을 갈아입고, 검은 인벤토리 깊숙이 처박은 다음 [예리한 창]을 꺼냈다.

findings.correction: I couldn’t have a two-meter iron spear pop out of thin air whenever I needed one.
findings.current: I couldn’t have a two-meter iron cage materialize from thin air whenever I needed one.
findings.defect: 철창 is the two-meter iron spear, not a cage.
findings.rationale: Immediate context is [예리한 창] and concealing a spear during communal living. Modern ‘prison bars’ sense of 철창 does not apply.
findings.source: 필요할 때마다 허공에서 2m짜리 철창이 튀어나오는 마술을 보여 줄 수는 없는 법이다.

findings.correction: The Head Elder smiled faintly. Jin Wikyung, who had been gazing at that smile, asked me,
findings.current:
With a faint smile, the Head Elder stared at Jin Wikyung.

Jin Wikyung turned to me.
findings.defect: Subject of the gaze is reversed: Wikyung has been watching the Head Elder’s smile; the Head Elder does not stare at Wikyung.
findings.rationale: 빙긋 is the elder’s smile; 대장로의 웃음을 물끄러미 바라보던 진위경 names Wikyung as the one looking, then 내게 물었다.
findings.source: 빙긋. 대장로의 웃음을 물끄러미 바라보던 진위경이 내게 물었다.

findings.correction: Once I hung the wooden plaque engraved with *Squad Leader* at my waist, I felt like I’d become Ordinary Martial Artist #1 of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.current: Once I hung the wooden plaque engraved with *Squad Leader* at my waist, I felt like an ordinary martial artist of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.defect: Dropping 무사1 loses the nameless-extra gag (Martial Artist #1).
findings.rationale: 무사1 is a numbered-mob joke, not generic ‘ordinary martial artist’.
findings.source: 조장이라고 음각된 목패를 허리춤에 차자 태원진가의 평범한 무사1이 된 것 같았다.

findings.correction: *He helped. The Head Elder, of all people…*
findings.current: *He helped us. The Head Elder, of all people…*
findings.defect: 도움을 줬다 has no object ‘us’; the help is the elder’s rebuke restoring Wikyung’s composure.
findings.rationale: Prior sentences are about Wikyung being shaken and the elder’s cold 일침; adding ‘us’ changes who benefited.
findings.source: ‘도움을 줬다. 다른 누구도 아닌, 바로 그 대장로가……’

findings.correction: *What the hell is wrong with this AI?*
findings.defect: 어떻게 돼먹은 is crude contempt; the English is milder and less in character.
findings.rationale: 돼먹은 is a coarse slam at the NPC, not a neutral ‘what kind’.

findings.correction: One of the martial artists, holding a torch in a shaking hand, doubled over
findings.current: One of the martial artists holding a torch doubled over
findings.defect: Omits 떨리는 손으로; the torch-bearer is already shaking before he doubles over.
findings.rationale: The trembling is the first physical cue of horror and leads into the dropped torch.
findings.source: 떨리는 손으로 횃불을 들고 있던 무사 하나가 허리를 숙이는 것을 시작으로

findings.correction: Before I knew it I had arrived at the reconnaissance squad’s quarters, and my mouth fell open.
findings.current: Before I knew it, I had arrived at the reconnaissance squad’s quarters. I opened my mouth.
findings.defect: 입을 벌렸다 is a gape at the quarters, not starting to speak.
findings.rationale: The next lines are the building’s condition (cracked wood, stench, beehive), so the gesture is astonishment.
findings.source: 어느새 정찰조의 숙소에 도착한 나는 입을 벌렸다.

summary: Three scene-fact errors: 검은 is the issued sword (검+은), not a black Inventory or old clothes; 철창 is the iron spear, not a cage; Jin Wikyung gazes at the Head Elder’s smile, not the reverse.
